Word of God for the Week 29/10/2026 - Jesus Christ is indeed our joy & our glory! Because we believe in Him & love Him, we shall daily continue to rejoice with joy unspeakable full of His glory (1 Peter 1:8-9). Brethren, let’s also continue to praise Him in the beauty of His Holiness (Psalm 29:1-2) and asking in prayers with thanksgiving, (Phil 4:6), John 16:23-24 - for we shall continue to receive that joy full of His glory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. And Jesus! The king of Glory shall continue to make sure, all lines fall into pleasant places for us Psalm 16:5-6; because He is our inheritance & the cup of our blessings, amen! Psalm 16:1-11; 1 Thess 2:13-20; Psalm 92:1-15; 1 Peter 1:3-12; Psalm 35:27-28
